citation.authors: Sanchez-Aguadero N, Patino-Alonso MC, Mora-Simon S, Gomez-Marcos MA, Alonso-Dominguez R, Sanchez-Salgado B, Recio-Rodriguez JI, Garcia-Ortiz L
citation.title: Postprandial Effects of Breakfast Glycemic Index on Vascular Function among Young Healthy Adults: A Crossover Clinical Trial

population.description: 40 young healthy adults (20 men, 20 women) enrolled at 20-40 years from primary care in Salamanca, Spain; diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidaemia and cardiovascular disease excluded; Table 2 mean (SD).

protocols.name: water
protocols.description: Control: 350 mL water only after a 12 h overnight fast, seated, observed 120 min. start_hour 8.92 (08:55) derived: visits ran 08:15 to 10:55 and lasted 2 h 40 min; taking the last sample at 120 min as the end of the visit puts the meal 40 min after 08:15

protocols.name: hgi_breakfast
protocols.description: High-GI breakfast (200 mL grape juice, 40 g white bread, 29 g strawberry jam, 350 mL water; Table 1: 72.0 g carbohydrate, 3.9 g protein, 0.9 g fat, 0.29 g saturated fat, 1.6 g fiber; the carbohydrate excludes fibre, its energy share 91.4% being 72.0 x 4 of 315 kcal; protein plant: every item is a plant food, white bread the only cereal) eaten within 10 min after a 12 h overnight fast, seated, observed 120 min. start_hour 8.92 (08:55) derived: visits ran 08:15 to 10:55 and lasted 2 h 40 min; taking the last sample at 120 min as the end of the visit puts the meal 40 min after 08:15

meals.food: grape juice, white bread and strawberry jam

protocols.name: lgi_breakfast
protocols.description: Low-GI breakfast (150 g apple, 125 g low-fat natural yogurt, 3 shelled walnuts, 17.5 g 72% dark chocolate, 350 mL water; Table 1: 31.5 g carbohydrate, 9.7 g protein, 19.9 g fat, 1.54 g saturated fat, 6.0 g fiber; the carbohydrate excludes fibre, its energy share 35.4% being 31.5 x 4 of 356 kcal; protein_source not entered: dairy and plant items, and no split printed) eaten within 10 min after a 12 h overnight fast, seated, observed 120 min. start_hour 8.92 (08:55) derived: visits ran 08:15 to 10:55 and lasted 2 h 40 min; taking the last sample at 120 min as the end of the visit puts the meal 40 min after 08:15

meals.food: apple, low-fat natural yogurt, walnuts and 72% dark chocolate

left_out.what: serum insulin at 0, 60 and 120 min in all three arms (Table 3) and in Results 3.3-3.4: the unit is printed only as 'mg/dL', which is impossible for insulin, and the paper states no other unit
augmentation index, augmentation pressure and central pulse pressure (Table 3, Figure 1, Figure 2c) and AIx iAUC (Results 3.4, p values only)
peripheral (brachial) pulse pressure, systolic minus diastolic, at 0, 30, 60 and 120 min (Table 3) and in Results 3.2; systolic and diastolic pressures not printed separately
heart rate and pressures every 15 min, and glucose and insulin time courses (Figures 1-3); by-sex responses (Supplemental Figures S2-S4, Tables S1-S3, not in the full text)
systolic and diastolic blood pressure and heart rate in the participants' table (Table 2): measured at every visit, and the table does not say which visit or time it prints
between-breakfast mean differences of glucose (+9.43 mg/dL at 60 min) and pulse pressure (Results 3.4), printed with p values and no uncertainty

Pearson correlations, across people, of the change from baseline to 120 min in insulin with the changes in HR, peripheral and central pulse pressure (Results 3.5); insulin's unit is also unusable (above)
